context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 147 added Toxic Spike Autopsy feature. All 23 tests pass. The ToxicSpikeAutopsyPanel import was missing in AdminPanel.jsx and was fixed during testing. The deep-link bridge (risedual:open-admin-autopsy event) was not tested as no toxic_spike notification was present, but the Admin -> Insights -> Toxic Autopsy tab renders correctly.
